context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 22 validated the new Insider Result analytics dashboard with 4 tabs: 1) Customer Lifecycle - tracks Active/Inactive/Lost customers with pie chart and trend. 2) Sales Forecast - shows revenue trends with 3-month moving average forecasts. 3) SPIP Analysis - identifies inventory gaps (out_of_stock, understocked, dead_stock, overstocked, balanced). 4) Concentration Risk - Pareto analysis showing customer revenue concentration (High Risk: 62% from top 5). All endpoints use strict tenant_id + company_id isolation via _build_query(). test_admin (different tenant) correctly sees 0 data. Admin with ASA AUTOTECH company sees 42 customers, 14 months of sales data, 202 inventory items.
